CATALOG_ARCHIVE_INVALID: input is not a ZIP archive
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_EXPANSION_RATIO_EXCEEDED: entry expands by more than 100 to 1
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID: entry is absolute, traversing, backslashed, or contains NUL
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_PATH_DUPLICATE: two entries have the same normalized path
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN: entry has a symbolic-link Unix mode
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_ENCRYPTION_FORBIDDEN: entry has the encrypted general-purpose bit
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DOCUMENT_MALFORMED: manifest or resource detail cannot be decoded
